notes: τῶν ἀνδρῶν ἐκείνων leaves the first article unrepresented under rule 38, the attributive demonstrative occupying the determiner slot, with the case preposition staying on the noun under rule 21's determinerless clause.
The second τῶν before κεκλημένων is unrepresented under rules 23 and 31, the article governing an expressed head noun so that the relativizer is the participle's helper.
